Direct-match candidates are present for sleep apnea, including multiple generic “Sleep apnea” scores (PGS003204–PGS003218) and several “Obstructive sleep apnea” scores (PGS003479, PGS003857, PGS003858, PGS005219, PGS005220). Competing genome-wide PRS-CS/auto models (e.g., PGS001792/PGS001797/PGS002761) have strong methodological properties and/or large validation, but their PRS-comparable evidence is weaker or less complete here (e.g., only Nagelkerke R2 ~0.03 or OR=1.68 without AUC), while several UKB framework/portability scores (PGS001321/PGS001322/PGS001323, PGS001836, PGS002043) are explicitly penalized by domain guidance as framework-derived and not typically preferred over disease-focused alternatives.
